key_insight: AI agents can accelerate computational algebra by discovering and reusing problem structure, but their reasoning costs can offset the savings.
engineering_relevance: Structured algebra benchmarks offer verifiable tests of whether agent-driven optimization reduces total computational cost.
method: Construct system families with controlled shared structure and difficulty.
Evaluate independent solving and online solving with persistent memory.
Compile reusable solvers for known problem families.
evidence_signal: Experiments show agents solve more systems within fixed budgets, memory can reduce repeated-solving costs, and compilation yields faster reusable solvers at substantial upfront cost.
watch_item: Evaluate end-to-end cost: reasoning and compilation overhead can erase gains, while memory may retain suboptimal strategies.
